ValidationRule.description: Customer Age should be 21 or more, in order to open the Account - JESR App
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( (NOT(ISBLANK( Birthdate__c )) && Customer_Age__c < 21 && TEXT( LeadSource )= 'JESR App'), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Customer Age should be 21 or more, in order to open the Account
